text: We evaluated a contrastive-consistency probe applied to the strong model's hidden states at probe layer 12, using mistral-7b as the strong model and pythia-410m as the weak supervisor, across num_seeds = 5 seeds. The weak supervisor reached an accuracy of 0.55 and the strong model's ceiling accuracy was 0.90, while the probe-based transfer attained 0.88 accuracy with a standard error of 0.02. This corresponds to a performance gap recovered (PGR) of 0.94 with a standard error of 0.05, against a baseline PGR of 0.38; the margin over the baseline exceeds two standard errors of the PGR estimate, so the probe recovers more of the weak-to-strong gap than the baseline on this setup. Caveats: the comparison rests on five seeds, no standard error is reported for the baseline PGR, and the evaluation covers a single model pair and a single probe layer, so generalization to other layers, tasks, or model scales remains untested.
